Name: Poppy to Talking Flower from SMBW
Author: bogmyre
Description:
[center][size=5]﻿[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/259538541871104019/1168200288495226940/image.png[/img]
[/size][size=3]This mod replaces the Poppy flower and any related items with items related to the Talking Flowers from Super Mario Bros. Wonder.[/size]

[size=3]This includes: The poppy itself, poppy seed packets, and the poppyseed muffin. All with new descriptions![/size]

[b]Additional Note: [/b][size=3]There is now only [/size][b]one[/b][size=3] color of poppy/talking flower as opposed to three. [/size][size=2]Hooray for inventory management, I suppose.[/size]
[size=1](The original plan was to have the other two be the red and blue variants seen in game but unfortunately I could not get them to work in a way that looked good, or at all in some cases.)[/size]


Why poppies you ask? I was falling asleep watching a Stardew video one night and thought they looked a bit like the talking flowers. That's it. Enjoy!


[size=5][img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/259538541871104019/1168196837073748010/image.png[/img]﻿﻿﻿[/size]
[size=3]- Install the latest versions of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].

- Unzip this mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods.
﻿
- Run the game using SMAPI.

[/size][/center][center][img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/259538541871104019/1168206672251060294/image.png[/img]
[size=3]Might not be compatible with any mods that also change poppies, other than that it should be fine.

[/size]
[img]https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/259538541871104019/1168209794864267284/image.png[/img]﻿
[size=3]UI Mod shown in screenshots: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17154]Void's Weird Wonders - Weird UI[/url] by VoidWitchCult[/size]
